# FISHKAL — Deep Catch (Single-file Edition)

سفر سینمایی تعاملی ماهیگیری در ساحل دبی — نسخه تک‌فایل مستقل FISHKAL.

## Kit

- HTML
- Google Fonts

## اجرا

```bash
# مستقیم در مرورگر باز کنید، یا:
python -m http.server 8000
```

> تک‌فایل؛ معادل مستقل نسخه وب FISHKAL.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
<title>FISHKAL — Deep Catch</title>
<script>
window.__fishkalBooted=false;
window.__fishkalFailed=false;
function fkFallback(why){
  try{
    if(window.__fishkalBooted||window.__fishkalFailed) return;
    window.__fishkalFailed=true;
    window.__fkFailReason=why;
    var b=document.getElementById('boot'); if(b) b.style.display='none';
    var f=document.getElementById('fallback'); if(f){ f.classList.add('on'); f.removeAttribute('hidden'); }
    var r=document.getElementById('result'); if(r) r.classList.remove('on');
    if(window.console&&console.warn) console.warn('[FISHKAL] fallback:',why);
  }catch(e){}
}
window.addEventListener('error',function(e){ if(!window.__fishkalBooted) fkFallback((e&&e.message)||'script error'); },true);
window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',function(){ if(!window.__fishkalBooted) fkFallback('promise rejection'); });
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){ setTimeout(function(){ if(!window.__fishkalBooted) fkFallback('boot timed out (6s)'); },6000); });
</script>
<meta name="description" content="An interactive cinematic fishing journey off the coast of Dubai. Descend into the deep, wait for the fish, strike at the right moment." />
<meta name="theme-color" content="#04161d" />
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
<meta name="apple-mobile-web-app-status-bar-style" content="black-translucent" />
<link rel="manifest" id="fkManifest" href='data:application/manifest+json,%7B%22name%22%3A%22FISHKAL%20%E2%80%94%20Deep%20Catch%22%2C%22short_name%22%3A%22FISHKAL%22%2C%22display%22%3A%22standalone%22%7D' />
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" id="fkAppleIcon" sizes="180x180" />
<meta name="mobile-web-app-capable" content="yes" />
<meta property="og:title" content="FISHKAL — Deep Catch" />
<meta property="og:description" content="Leave Dubai. Drop the hook. Time the strike." />
<meta property="og:type" content="website" />
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' fill='%2304161d'/%3E%3Cpath d='M6 16c4-6 12-6 16 0-4 6-12 6-16 0z' fill='none' stroke='%23d9a45c' stroke-width='1.6'/%3E%3Ccircle cx='19' cy='15' r='1.2' fill='%23d9a45c'/%3E%3C/svg%3E" />
<style>
#fallback{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:60;display:none;place-items:center;text-align:center;
  padding:24px;background:
    radial-gradient(120% 80% at 50% 0%,#123347 0%,#062a35 42%,#03121a 100%);
  color:#efe6d6;font:400 15px/1.7 Archivo,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif}
#fallback.on{display:grid}
#fallback .fbmark{font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.42em;text-indent:.42em;text-transform:uppercase;
  font-size:clamp(22px,7vw,40px);color:#efe6d6}
#fallback .fbsub{margin-top:10px;color:#63d8d2;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px}
#fallback .fbline{width:64px;height:1px;background:rgba(217,164,92,.6);margin:22px auto}
#fallback p{max-width:34em;color:rgba(239,230,214,.72);margin:0 auto}
#fallback .fbcue{margin-top:20px;color:#d9a45c;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:10px}
#fallback a{color:#63d8d2}
</style>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Archivo:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Vazirmatn:wght@400;500;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  color-scheme: dark;
  --abyss:#03121a;
  --deep:#062a35;
  --teal:#0d5d63;
  --turq:#1a8f8a;
  --gold:#d9a45c;
  --brass:#8a6a33;
  --sand:#efe6d6;
  --aqua:#63d8d2;
  --ink:#02090d;

  --fg:#efe6d6;
  --fg-dim:rgba(239,230,214,.62);
  --fg-faint:rgba(239,230,214,.34);
  --line:rgba(239,230,214,.18);

  --font:'Archivo','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,system-ui,sans-serif;
  --track:.34em;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
}
:root:not([data-theme="light"]){ --fg:#efe6d6; }
:root[data-theme="dark"]{ --fg:#efe6d6; }

*{box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;overflow-x:hidden}
html{scroll-behavior:auto}
body{
  background:var(--ink);
  color:var(--fg);
  font-family:var(--font);
  font-weight:400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overscroll-behavior-y:none;
}

#stage{
  position:fixed;inset:0;
  width:100%;height:100vh;height:100dvh;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:var(--ink);
  z-index:1;
}
#world{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
#ov{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;overflow:visible}
#ui{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none}
#spacer{position:relative;z-index:0;width:100%}

.scrim{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2}
.scrim.top{top:0;height:30vh;background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(2,9,13,.62),rgba(2,9,13,0))}
.scrim.bot{bottom:0;height:34vh;background:linear-gradient(to top,rgba(2,9,13,.72),rgba(2,9,13,0))}

.label{
  font-size:clamp(9px,2.5vw,11px);
  letter-spacing:var(--track);
  text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--fg-dim);
  font-weight:500;
}
.wordmark{
  font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.42em;
  text-indent:.42em;
  text-transform:uppercase;
  line-height:1;
}

#hero{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:16vh;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:18px;
  padding:0 24px;text-align:center;
}
#hero .mark{font-size:clamp(34px,11.5vw,84px)}
#hero .sub{
  font-size:clamp(10px,2.9vw,13px);letter-spacing:.5em;text-indent:.5em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);font-weight:500;
}
#hero .meta{color:var(--fg-faint)}

#hint{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:5.5vh;text-align:center;
  color:var(--fg-faint);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;
}
#hint .chev{display:block;margin:10px auto 0;width:14px;height:14px;border-right:1px solid var(--fg-faint);border-bottom:1px solid var(--fg-faint);transform:rotate(45deg);animation:drift 2.6s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes drift{0%,100%{transform:rotate(45deg) translate(0,0);opacity:.35}50%{transform:rotate(45deg) translate(3px,3px);opacity:.85}}

#caption{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 8vh);
  text-align:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity .9s var(--ease);
}
#caption .big{
  font-size:clamp(17px,5.4vw,28px);font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:.3em;text-indent:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;
}
#caption .small{margin-top:9px;color:var(--fg-faint)}

#cue{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:13vh;text-align:center;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .7s var(--ease);
  color:var(--fg-dim);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.36em;text-transform:uppercase;
}

#result{
  position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-46%) scale(.965);
  width:min(86vw,360px);
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;
  transition:opacity .8s var(--ease),transform .9s var(--ease);
  padding:26px 22px 24px;
  text-align:center;
}
#result.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) scale(1)}
#result .frame{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
#result .kicker{color:var(--gold);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.42em;text-transform:uppercase}
#result .name{margin:13px 0 6px;font-size:clamp(21px,6.4vw,30px);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.2em;text-indent:.2em;text-transform:uppercase}
#result .latin{font-style:italic;font-size:12px;color:var(--fg-faint);letter-spacing:.04em}
#result .line{margin-top:17px;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--fg-dim);max-width:30ch;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
#result .sig{margin-top:18px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;color:var(--fg-faint);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.4em;text-transform:uppercase}
#result .sig i{display:block;width:26px;height:1px;background:var(--line)}

#brand{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:26px;
  padding:0 26px;text-align:center;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;
  transition:opacity 1s var(--ease);
}
#brand.on{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
#brand .mark{font-size:clamp(30px,9.5vw,64px)}
#brand .tag{color:var(--fg-dim);font-size:clamp(12px,3.4vw,14px);line-height:1.7;max-width:34ch}
#cta{
  pointer-events:auto;margin-top:6px;
  appearance:none;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid rgba(217,164,92,.5);
  color:var(--sand);font-family:var(--font);font-weight:500;
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;
  padding:15px 30px;border-radius:2px;
  transition:border-color .45s var(--ease),background-color .45s var(--ease),color .45s var(--ease);
}
#cta:hover,#cta:focus-visible{border-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(217,164,92,.1);color:#fff}

#sound{
  position:absolute;pointer-events:auto;
  right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right,0px) + 16px);
  top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 16px);
  width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;
  display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;
  background:rgba(3,18,26,.42);border:1px solid var(--line);
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  transition:border-color .4s var(--ease);z-index:6;
}
#sound:hover,#sound:focus-visible{border-color:rgba(217,164,92,.55)}
#sound svg{width:17px;height:17px;stroke:var(--fg-dim);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
#sound[aria-pressed="true"] .x{opacity:0}
#sound[aria-pressed="false"] .x{opacity:1}
#sound[aria-pressed="true"] .w{opacity:1}
#sound[aria-pressed="false"] .w{opacity:0}

#strike{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  appearance:none;background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;margin:0;
  cursor:pointer;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;z-index:5;
  font:inherit;color:transparent;
}
#strike.live{pointer-events:auto}
#strike:focus-visible{opacity:1;outline:none;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(99,216,210,.5)}

.sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;margin:-1px;padding:0;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}

#continue{
  position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:6vh;text-align:center;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .8s var(--ease);
  color:var(--fg-faint);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.34em;text-transform:uppercase;
}
#continue .chev{display:block;margin:9px auto 0;width:12px;height:12px;border-right:1px solid var(--fg-faint);border-bottom:1px solid var(--fg-faint);transform:rotate(45deg);animation:drift 2.6s var(--ease) infinite}


#langWrap{
  position:absolute;pointer-events:auto;
  left:calc(env(safe-area-inset-left,0px) + 16px);
  top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + 16px);
  z-index:6;
}
#langBtn{
  height:40px;min-width:54px;padding:0 13px;border-radius:20px;
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;cursor:pointer;
  background:rgba(3,18,26,.42);border:1px solid var(--line);
  color:var(--fg-dim);font-family:var(--font);font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  transition:border-color .4s var(--ease),color .4s var(--ease);
}
#langBtn:hover,#langBtn:focus-visible{border-color:rgba(217,164,92,.55);color:var(--sand)}
#langBtn svg{width:9px;height:9px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;transition:transform .3s var(--ease)}
#langBtn[aria-expanded="true"] svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
#langMenu{
  position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 8px);left:0;min-width:132px;
  padding:6px;border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(3,18,26,.88);border:1px solid var(--line);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;
  box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
#langMenu[hidden]{display:none}
#langMenu button{
  appearance:none;background:transparent;border:0;cursor:pointer;text-align:start;
  color:var(--fg-dim);font-family:var(--font);font-size:12.5px;font-weight:500;
  padding:9px 12px;border-radius:8px;transition:background-color .25s var(--ease),color .25s var(--ease);
}
#langMenu button:hover,#langMenu button:focus-visible{background:rgba(239,230,214,.08);color:var(--sand)}
#langMenu button.on{color:var(--gold)}
@media (max-width:380px){ #langBtn{min-width:46px;padding:0 10px} }

#rClose{
  position:absolute;top:5px;inset-inline-end:5px;min-width:44px;min-height:44px;width:44px;height:44px;
  display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer;pointer-events:auto;
  background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:50%;
  color:var(--fg-faint);transition:color .3s var(--ease),border-color .3s var(--ease);
}
#rClose:hover,#rClose:focus-visible{color:var(--gold);border-color:rgba(217,164,92,.45)}
#rClose svg{width:12px;height:12px;display:block}

#depth{
  position:absolute;right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right,0px) + 20px);top:50%;
  transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:4;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  opacity:0;transition:opacity .9s var(--ease);
}
#depth .track{position:relative;width:1px;height:118px;background:var(--line)}
#depthFill{position:absolute;top:0;left:-.75px;width:2.5px;height:0%;background:linear-gradient(rgba(99,216,210,.85),rgba(99,216,210,.15))}
#depthDot{position:absolute;left:50%;top:0%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--aqua);box-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(99,216,210,.85)}
#depthTxt{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:var(--fg-dim);font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
#depthLbl{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-indent:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--fg-faint)}

#boot{
  position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:40;background:var(--ink);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:20px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  transition:opacity .9s var(--ease);pointer-events:none;
}
#boot .bmark{font-size:clamp(20px,6.4vw,32px);color:var(--sand)}
#boot .bline{width:118px;height:1px;background:var(--line);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#boot .bline i{position:absolute;inset:0;background:var(--gold);animation:bsweep 1.5s var(--ease) infinite}
@keyframes bsweep{0%{transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left}52%{transform:scaleX(1);transform-origin:left}53%{transform-origin:right}100%{transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:right}}
#boot.done{opacity:0}

#log{color:var(--fg-faint);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-indent:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;min-height:12px}

:root[data-lang="ar"],:root[data-lang="fa"]{ --font:'Vazirmatn','Archivo',Helvetica,Arial,system-ui,sans-serif; --track:.16em; }
.wordmark,#langBtn,#depthTxt,#boot .bmark{font-family:'Archivo','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif}
html[dir="rtl"] #result .name,
html[dir="rtl"] #caption .big,
html[dir="rtl"] #hero .sub{letter-spacing:.07em;text-indent:.07em}
html[dir="rtl"] #result .kicker{letter-spacing:.2em}

@media (max-width:420px){
  #result{width:min(88vw,340px);padding:24px 18px 20px}
  #depth .track{height:92px}
  #depth{right:calc(env(safe-area-inset-right,0px) + 14px)}
}
@media (max-height:470px){
  #hero .mark{font-size:clamp(24px,8vh,42px)}
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  #hint .chev,#continue .chev{animation:none}
  *{transition-duration:.01ms !important}
}
@media (max-aspect-ratio: 11/10){
  #hero{bottom:auto;top:9.5vh}
  #hint{bottom:4vh}
}
@media (max-width:360px){
  #hero{bottom:14vh;gap:14px}
  #result{padding:22px 16px 20px}
}
</style>
<script type="application/ld+json">
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Brand","name":"FISHKAL","slogan":"Deep Catch","areaServed":{"@type":"City","name":"Dubai"}}
</script>
<style>
#bizBar{position:fixed;bottom:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:9;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;max-width:94vw;
  padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(2,9,13,.55);border:1px solid var(--line);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}
#bizBar .cd{color:var(--gold);font:600 10px/1 'Archivo',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.18em;white-space:nowrap}
#installBtn{display:none;align-items:center;gap:7px;padding:9px 16px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--gold);
  background:rgba(217,164,92,.14);color:var(--gold);cursor:pointer;font:600 10px/1 'Archivo',sans-serif;
  letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}
#installBtn svg{width:13px;height:13px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.7;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
html[dir="rtl"] #bizBar *{font-family:'Vazirmatn',sans-serif!important;letter-spacing:.02em!important;font-size:11px!important}
#logoChip{position:fixed;top:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:8;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
  padding:7px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(2,9,13,.5);border:1px solid var(--line);
  backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);color:var(--sand);cursor:pointer}
#logoChip b{font:700 12px/1 'Archivo',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--sand)}
#logoChip small{font:500 7px/1 'Archivo',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--fg-dim)}
#logoChip .clk{color:var(--aqua);font:600 10px/1 'Archivo',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;border-inline-start:1px solid var(--line);padding-inline-start:9px}
#logoChip svg{height:30px;width:61px;display:block}
@media(max-width:480px){#logoChip .clk{display:none}#logoChip svg{height:26px;width:53px}#logoChip{gap:7px;padding:6px 12px}}
@media(max-width:560px){#logoChip small{display:none}}
#depthVeil{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;opacity:0;
  background:linear-gradient(rgba(1,8,12,0),rgba(1,8,12,.85) 70%,rgba(0,4,7,.95))}
#amb{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
.lf{width:17px;height:12px;border-radius:2.5px;overflow:hidden;flex:none;display:inline-flex;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(239,230,214,.22)}
.lf svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
#langBtn .lf{margin-inline-end:1px}
#langBtn .lf svg{width:100%;height:100%;stroke:none;transition:none;transform:none!important}
#langMenu button .lf{margin-inline-end:2px}
#langMenu{max-height:min(70vh,430px);overflow-y:auto}
#footLine{margin-top:8px;text-align:center;color:rgba(239,230,214,.4);font:500 9px/1.6 'Archivo',sans-serif;letter-spacing:.18em}
@media(max-width:700px){
  #bizBar{left:0;right:0;bottom:0;transform:none;max-width:none;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;
    padding:10px 14px calc(10px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
  #bizBar .cd{flex:1 1 100%;text-align:center;font-size:10px}
  #installBtn{flex:1 1 40%;justify-content:center;padding:11px 10px}
  #logoChip{top:10px;padding:6px 12px}
}
@media(pointer:coarse){
  #sound,#langBtn{min-height:44px;min-width:44px}
  #installBtn{min-height:44px}
}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{touch-action:manipulation;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
@media(min-width:1800px){
  #langBtn{height:48px;font-size:13px;padding:0 18px}
  #langWrap,#sound{top:24px}
  #sound{width:48px;height:48px;right:24px}
  #langWrap{left:24px}
  #logoChip{top:22px;padding:10px 20px}
  #logoChip svg{height:38px;width:78px}
  #logoChip b{font-size:15px}
  #logoChip .clk{font-size:12px}
  #bizBar{bottom:24px;gap:14px;padding:12px 16px}

  const cap=quality>=2?2.25:1.35;
  DPR=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,cap);
  cv.width=Math.round(W*DPR); cv.height=Math.round(H*DPR);
  ctx.setTransform(DPR,0,0,DPR,0,0);
  ov.setAttribute('viewBox',`0 0 ${W} ${H}`);
  ov.setAttribute('width',W); ov.setAttribute('height',H);
  layoutScroll();
  buildVignette();
  layoutHud();
}

let locked=true, rawP=0, P=0, lastScrollY=0;

function layoutScroll(){
  const range=H*(SCREENS-1);
  const h=H+(locked?TL.LOCK*range:range);
  spacer.style.height=h+'px';
}
window.__fkScrollPin=null;
function readScroll(){
  if(window.__fkScrollPin!=null){ rawP=window.__fkScrollPin; return; }
  const range=H*(SCREENS-1);
  rawP=clamp(window.scrollY/range,0,1);
}
function unlockScroll(){
  if(!locked) return;
  locked=false; layoutScroll();
  ui.cont.style.opacity='1';
  setTimeout(()=>{ui.cont.style.opacity='0';},5200);
}

const cam={horizonY:0,meniscusY:0,depth:0,sunX:0,sunY:0,hullX:0,hullS:1,above:1};
let rodTip={x:0,y:0,v:false};

function updateCamera(p,t){
  heroTransform(p,t);
  cam.horizonY=i2sy(IMG.horizon);
  cam.sunX=clamp(i2sx(IMG.sunX),W*0.14,W*0.86);
  cam.sunY=i2sy(IMG.sunY);
  cam.hullX=i2sx(IMG.hullCx);
  cam.hullS=((IMG.hullR-IMG.hullL)/310)*heroT.sc;
  rodTip.x=i2sx(IMG.rodX); rodTip.y=i2sy(IMG.rodY); rodTip.v=true;

  if(p<TL.DESCENT[0]){ cam.meniscusY=H*1.6; }
  else{
    const d=smoothstep(TL.DESCENT[0],TL.HOOK[0],p);
    cam.meniscusY=lerp(H*1.35,-H*0.28,easeInOut(d));
  }
  if(p>TL.ASCENT[0]){
    const a=smoothstep(.80,.925,p);
    if(a>0) cam.meniscusY=lerp(-H*0.28,H*1.5,easeInOut(a));
  }
  cam.depth=p<=TL.LOCK
    ? smoothstep(.50,.60,p)
    : 1-smoothstep(.655,.885,p);
  cam.above=clamp(cam.meniscusY/H,0,1);
}

let vig=null, grainTile=null;
function buildVignette(){
  const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=W; c.height=H;
  const g=c.getContext('2d');
  const rg=g.createRadialGradient(W*.5,H*.48,Math.min(W,H)*.22,W*.5,H*.5,Math.max(W,H)*.78);
  rg.addColorStop(0,'rgba(2,9,13,0)');
  rg.addColorStop(.62,'rgba(2,9,13,.22)');
  rg.addColorStop(1,'rgba(2,9,13,.78)');
  g.fillStyle=rg; g.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  vig=c;
}
function buildGrain(){
  if(reduced) return;
  const s=128;
  const c=document.createElement('canvas'); c.width=s; c.height=s;
  const g=c.getContext('2d');
  const img=g.createImageData(s,s);
  for(let i=0;i<s*s;i++){
    const v=Math.random()*255|0;
    img.data[i*4]=v; img.data[i*4+1]=v; img.data[i*4+2]=v;
    img.data[i*4+3]=Math.random()*26|0;
  }
  g.putImageData(img,0,0);
  grainTile=ctx.createPattern(c,'repeat');
}
